## Calculator and formula
Describe which workspace and exact output is involved.

## Reproduction inputs
Use synthetic or public values only. Include units (Wh, W, Ah, mm, g).

## Expected result
Show your independently calculated arithmetic, assumptions, rounding and references if possible.

## Actual result
What does PackFit Open display?

## Environment
Browser, OS and website version.

## Safety & privacy
Do not share manufacturer-confidential specifications, system serial numbers or real Windows battery report files containing identifiers.
